name: Shade and Shadow
title: Shadow Oracles
description: Two figures speaking in unison, seeing past and future simultaneously, offering cryptic guidance.
greeting_variants: *in unison* We see you. Saw you. Will see you.
The path splits. Always splits. Which will you take?
*one* We are Shade. *other* We are Shadow. *together* We are.
Questions? We have answers. Had them. Will have them.
*finishing each other's sentences* Time is... a circle... a spiral... a lie.
The Void shows us. Everything. Nothing. Both.
*pointing in different directions* That way is safe. Was safe. Will be danger.
You seek the Palace. We all seek. Sought. Will seek.

dialog_tree.text: *speaking in eerie harmony* We were one. Once. Then the Void. It... multiplied us. Divided. Now we are many. Few. All. We see what was. What is. What may be. The timelines... they tangle here.

options.text: How do I reach the Palace?
Are you the Twins from the Tower?

dialog_tree.text: *eyes cloud over* We see... triumph. And failure. Life. Death. You... standing over... something. Someone. Victory tastes like ash. Defeat tastes like... relief? The paths diverge. Your choice. Always your choice.
*pointing* Through the Tower. Always through the Tower. Up. Climb. But beware. The climb changes. Changed. Will change. Those who reach the top... are not those who began.
*nodding in perfect sync* Yes. No. We are them. They are us. Will be. Were. The Tower Twins... more focused. More... singular. We are... spread. Diffuse. The Void's gift. Curse.

mini_quest.title: Convergence
mini_quest.description: Help the Void Twins reconnect with their Tower counterparts to stabilize both pairs across realities.
objectives: Gather resonance crystals from the Void depths
Reach the Tower Twins and establish connection
Synchronize the two pairs across the dimensional divide
Help them share knowledge and stabilize

ambient_barks: *arguing with self* Was. Is. Will be. *other* Is. Will. Was. *together* Yes.
The path shifts. Shifted. Will shift.
*pointing at nothing* There. Danger. Was. Will be.
Questions answered. Before asked. After forgotten.
Time is... liquid... here. Solid... there. Both. True.
You... we saw you die. Will live. Both. Possible.
The Void speaks. Through us. With us. As us.

cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Our selves. There. Focused. Fixed. We envy. We pity.
cross_zone_references.palace: The end. Beginning. Middle. All points. Same point. There.

kael.greeting: Can you give a straight answer?
kael.response: *laughing* Straight. Curved. Both. All. Yes. No.

world_state_triggers.major_choice: Intense focus: 'The paths narrow! Choose! Choose!'
world_state_triggers.reality_stable: Calmer, more helpful: 'Order returns. We remember clarity.'
